retrieval.predictor: R2 prior-weighted mean; mix=0.5 times mean posterior of retrieved neighbors
retrieval.five_shot: exact unchanged R2 support ridge lambda1; no gallery use

source_control_grid.selection: one fixed winner per source domain on held-out source images, matched source gallery only; candidate C and schema never selected

metric_boundary: Auxiliary source qualification, not replacement for canonical five Pets metrics. If it fails, record a rejected qualification report and decision without relabeling source metrics as Pets. If it passes, freeze trained candidate before all canonical Pets cells and separately gated Caltech acquisition.
method: four bounded relational coefficients, normalized exp weights, learned global alpha per shot; exact ridge.1
source_development_labels: Source query/support and source gallery labels available to all eligible learned controls; target labels used only for scoring.
pre_outcome_amendment: BCE uses one nuisance intercept while fitting binary prevalence; it cancels in normalized exp inference weights. Utility and BCE relative composition each have exactly four coefficients. No source-conditional prior transfer.
